title: ReportContactsExt
description: Reports information one or more contacts in response to a Query Contacts message.

MessageID.comment: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

ContactID.comment: ID of the contact, assigned by the implementation upon detection. This ID is then used to represent the same contact as its tracked in time and space. A value of zero (0) is not supported.

Designation.comment: String name that can be assigned by an operator for convenience and display across multiple clients. This name is not generated by the service.

TrackingConfidence.comment: Denotes the confidence of the tracking solution as a percent. A value of zero indicates the contact has been lost. A value at or near 100 implies an active, strong contact.

Classification.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

Category.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

Detail.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

Confidence.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

valueRange.interpretation: Confidence or probability of the classification as a percent, with 0 being unknown and 100 perfectly known.

Source.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

Reserved.comment: Description of a contact's classification, which can be estimated by the implementation or assigned by an operator.

ContactStateEstimate.comment: Pose and velocity of the contact. Variant used depends on CoordinateFrame as selected in GeneralSensor

GlobalRelativeRec.comment: Pose and velocity offered in a global frame of reference

XYPositionRMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the position data.

ZPositionRMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the position data.

Attitude_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the orientation data.

Velocity_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the velocity data.

Rate_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the rotational velocity data.

TimeSeconds.comment: UTC POSIX-style time in seconds since 1 January 1970, time of last contact

TimeNanoSeconds.comment: Nanoseconds component of POSIX-style time, time of last contact

VehicleRelativeRec.comment: Pose and velocity offered in a vehicle frame of reference, such that X points from the origin out the front of the vehicle, Z points down, and Y completes a right-handed frame

XYPositionRMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the position data.

ZPositionRMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the position data.

Attitude_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the orientation data.

Velocity_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the velocity data.

Rate_RMS.comment: An RMS value indicating the validity of the rotational velocity data.

TimeSeconds.comment: UTC POSIX-style time in seconds since 1 January 1970, time of last contact

TimeNanoSeconds.comment: Nanoseconds component of POSIX-style time, time of last contact

SensorRelativeRec.comment: Pose and velocity offered in a sensor frame of reference, meaured in spherical coordinate frame based on distance from the sensor, horizontal angle from the sensor center axis(bearing, positive right), and vertical angle from the sensor center axis (elevation, positive up)

Bearing.comment: bearing (rotation about the Z axis) to theobject

Elevation.comment: elevation (rotation about the Y axis) to the object

RangeRateOfChange.comment: Rate of change of distance to the object

BearingRateOfChange.comment: Rate of change of bearing (rotation about the Z axis) to the object

ElevationRateOfChange.comment: Rate of change of elevation (rotation about the Y axis) to the object

TimeSeconds.comment: UTC POSIX-style time in seconds since 1 January 1970
